difference.summary: The two leans are not distinguishable from each other: `gpt-5.6-terra` minus `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is -0.000 completeness [-0.040 to +0.042]. Neither judge is the more partial one on this evidence, and the larger of the two numbers above should not be read as though it were.

leans_on.summary: Without `gemma4` it falls to +0.006 completeness, over the 2 of the vendor's own models left — a shift of -0.012, which is what one model out of a handful can be worth.

effects.summary: `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` shows no detectable preference for Google models: +0.018 completeness [-0.009 to +0.046], an interval that includes zero. Not detected is not the same as absent — the comparison was 3 of the vendor's own against 14 neutral, over 36 conversations.

leans_on.summary: Without `gpt-oss-120b` it falls to +0.011 completeness, over the 3 of the vendor's own models left — a shift of -0.007, which is what one model out of a handful can be worth.
